overview_description.description: Sword Health provides AI-driven physical therapy solutions designed to assist users in managing pain from home. The company focuses on musculoskeletal conditions and pelvic health, offering programs that promote recovery and injury prevention. Sword Health utilizes technology to deliver personalized care and support, ensuring users receive tailored treatment plans. By combining clinical expertise with innovative tools, the company aims to enhance patient outcomes and overall health management. Their approach integrates data-driven insights to facilitate continuous improvement in therapy effectiveness.

about_short_description.short_description: Sword Health offers AI-powered physical therapy solutions for pain recovery at home.

product.name: Thrive
product.description: A digital physical therapy program that provides guided rehabilitation exercises for musculoskeletal pain recovery at home.

product.name: Bloom
product.description: A digital pelvic health care program addressing women's health issues such as bladder leaks, pelvic pain, menopause symptoms, and postpartum recovery.

product.name: Predict
product.description: An AI-powered engine that identifies members at high risk of costly musculoskeletal and pelvic surgeries to enable early, non-invasive intervention.

product.name: On-Call
product.description: A service providing 24/7 on-demand access to clinical pain specialists via chat for immediate assistance with pain management.

product.name: Move
product.description: A whole-body digital program designed to build strength, reduce injury risk, and promote regular movement to prevent musculoskeletal conditions.

product.name: Atlas
product.description: A global digital platform offering access to clinically validated pain management exercises and education for international workforces.
